items.a: When we can do **anything**, do we still know what we **want**?

items.q: What personal fear sits under job fear?
items.a: If craft no longer proves identity, **what's special about me?**

items.q: What happens when you ask AI for a journal?
items.a: It may ship **mood scores, streaks, reminders, weekly reports**—decisions you didn't choose.

items.q: What should good tools do with those decisions?
items.a: Make **assumptions visible**, keep changes **small**, let you **take the task back**.

items.q: What kind of tools does Ryo want?
items.a: Ones that **involve you more**—not proof they can work without you.
